 MEMO
 To:       Honorable Mayor Patrick Collins and Members of the City Council
 From:     Seth Lloyd, Planner
 Subject: UDC-22-00129 Cheyenne Fox Farm Final Plat
 Date:    August 15, 2022

The Cheyenne Fox Farm Final Plat was submitted to Council on 8/8/2022 (Item #17). After further
review of the submitted plat, a few corrections were requested. A revised map was submitted to Staff
on 8/15/2022 to address these issues.

The following are the changes on the map between the original council submittal and revised map:
    - Addition of a BOPU easement on the far northeast corner of Lot 5, Block 1.
    - Addition of the date of the David W. Trefren Revocable Trust to the dedication, signature, and
        notary.
The revised plat is otherwise identical to the map submitted to Council.

Staff recommends approval of the project for the reasons outlined in the original council packet, with
the revised map dated 8/15/2022.

Attachments:
    1. Final Plat Map (dated 8/15/2022)
